source.title: 8 Fantasy Football Breakout Players for 2026
source.author: Evan Tarracciano
source.summary: Eight players expected to exceed projections if their roles, health, and offensive environments cooperate.

takeaways.label: breakout
takeaways.summary: Healthy offensive tackles, strong receiving options, and Herbert's added rushing production create top-five quarterback upside.
takeaways.rationale: Healthy offensive tackles, strong receiving options, and Herbert's added rushing production create top-five quarterback upside.
risks: The case depends materially on improved line health.

takeaways.label: value
takeaways.summary: Goff's repeated top-eight finishes and elite passing volume make QB16 pricing overly pessimistic.
takeaways.rationale: Goff's repeated top-eight finishes and elite passing volume make QB16 pricing overly pessimistic.

takeaways.label: breakout
takeaways.summary: Skattebo is healthy, receiving-capable, and positioned as the clear lead back behind an improved Giants line.
takeaways.rationale: Skattebo is healthy, receiving-capable, and positioned as the clear lead back behind an improved Giants line.
risks: His physical style and major 2025 leg injury create durability risk.

takeaways.label: breakout
takeaways.summary: Price's first-round capital and limited healthy competition create a strong early workload at RB26 cost.
takeaways.rationale: Price's first-round capital and limited healthy competition create a strong early workload at RB26 cost.
risks: His receiving profile is less established and Zach Charbonnet may return.

takeaways.label: breakout
takeaways.summary: Egbuka can become Tampa Bay's lead receiver with Mike Evans gone and carries favorable WR schedule support.
takeaways.rationale: Egbuka can become Tampa Bay's lead receiver with Mike Evans gone and carries favorable WR schedule support.
risks: Toe health and Chris Godwin remain relevant risks.

takeaways.label: breakout
takeaways.summary: Moore is expected to become Josh Allen's first read and primary deep threat after leaving Chicago.
takeaways.rationale: Moore is expected to become Josh Allen's first read and primary deep threat after leaving Chicago.
risks: Camp chemistry must translate into regular-season target volume.

takeaways.label: breakout
takeaways.summary: Likely projects as the Giants' second read and red-zone mismatch after moving out of Mark Andrews' shadow.
takeaways.rationale: Likely projects as the Giants' second read and red-zone mismatch after moving out of Mark Andrews' shadow.
risks: The role is projected from camp reports in a new offense.

takeaways.label: breakout
takeaways.summary: Goedert can offset touchdown regression with increased targets after A.J. Brown's departure and Makai Lemon's injury.
takeaways.rationale: Goedert can offset touchdown regression with increased targets after A.J. Brown's departure and Makai Lemon's injury.
risks: His 11-touchdown 2025 season is unlikely to repeat.
